operating_notes.text: Q4FY26 cost of materials and goods was 57.9% of revenue against 59.9% in Q4FY25, holding EBITDA margin at 18.07%.
FY26 fiscal incentive income of ₹45.72 Cr for April 2024 to September 2025 was recognised in Q3FY26 after a State Government approval.
New Labour Codes led to a past service cost of ₹48.56 Cr (consolidated) recognised in Q3FY26 and FY26 towards gratuity and compensated absences.
Q4FY26 growth was ~9% in the first two months before moderating in March on supply disruptions in the International Business following the West Asia conflict.
E-commerce contributed ~6% to the Domestic business in FY26, driven by e-commerce-first launches and a premium mix.
Q4FY26 volume growth was close to 5.5%; domestic business grew close to 9-9.5% while the international business was negative for the quarter on West Asia disruption.
E-commerce was 6% of domestic sales in FY26 (4% in FY25), with quick commerce about 70% of e-commerce and adjacency categories growing 2.7x there.
Palm oil is covered for 5 months and wheat for 5.5-6 months at favourable prices; fuel and laminate costs are inflationary.
Consolidated related-party flows to parent Associated Biscuits International Limited (ABIL), UK were ₹808.57 Cr of expense in FY26, 4.2% of revenue.
Britannia Bel Foods Private Limited (JV) had FY26 purchases of goods of ₹269.15 Cr and sales of ₹144.38 Cr with the group, and posted a loss of ₹30.57 Cr.
Royalty and shared service expense to Nowrosjee Wadia and Sons Limited was ₹64.56 Cr in FY26 (FY25: ₹60.53 Cr).
General trade grew 1.5x of FY26 growth in Q1FY27
Other channels grew 2.5x of general trade in Q1FY27
Key states delivered 1.8x of FY26 growth in Q1FY27
At the 107th AGM, 27.5902% of public institution votes were cast against re-appointing Ness N. Wadia as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director.
Mr. Rejin Surendran was Global Chief Information Officer at Wipro Enterprises Private Limited, leading a technology team across 25 countries for over 4.5 years.
LIC held 1,20,59,614 shares, or 5.006% of Britannia's voting capital, after buying 53,260 shares in the market on 16 September 2026.

2026-05-07: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,686 Cr (+7.1% YoY), net profit ₹680 Cr (+21.6% YoY); FY26 revenue ₹18,858 Cr (+7.5%), net profit ₹2,537 Cr (+16.5%); final dividend of ₹90.5 per share recommended.
Britannia Industries Limited hosted an Investors/Analysts Conference Call on 8 May 2026 at 10:00 AM IST to discuss Q4 FY26 and FY26 results.
Britannia Industries Limited schedules a one-to-one virtual meet with an institutional investor on May 14, 2026, at 2:00 P.M. IST.

2026-05-11: Q4FY26 earnings call transcript: volume growth ~5.5%, revenue ₹4,686 Cr (+7.1% YoY), FY26 revenue ₹18,858 Cr (+7.5%); calibrated price hikes to start Q1FY27 on fuel and laminate inflation.
Britannia Industries Limited schedules one-to-one institutional investor meet with **Sona Rajora** on May 25, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST in Bengaluru.
Britannia Industries’ Management to participate in J.P. Morgan India Consumer CEO Fireside Chat Series virtually on May 29, 2026, at 2:00 P.M. IST.
Britannia Industries Limited schedules one-to-one institutional investor meet with Sona Rajora on June 12, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST in Bengaluru.
FY26 annual report (filed 16 July 2026) shows an unmodified audit opinion, ₹808.57 Cr of related-party expense to parent ABIL and ₹128.18 Cr of contingent liabilities.
2026-07-31: Shareholders passed the postal ballot re-appointing N. Venkataraman as Whole-Time Director
Britannia Industries re-appointed N. Venkataraman as Whole-Time Director and CFO for a 4-year term from 30 July 2026 to 29 July 2030 via shareholder approval through postal ballot.
Britannia Q1FY27 revenue rose 8.2% YoY to ₹5,000 Cr with PAT up 14.1% to ₹593 Cr
Britannia Industries elevated Mr. Piyush Bhandari and Mr. Abhishek Gaurav to Vice President - Commercial and Vice President - Replenishment respectively, effective 1 August 2026
2026-08-07: Britannia Industries held Q1FY27 results conference call presentation
2026-08-07: Britannia's 107th AGM passed all four resolutions
Britannia Industries Ltd reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹4,964 Cr with 9.5% YoY growth and PAT up 13.6% YoY.
2026-08-31: Britannia said CIO Susheel Navanale will retire on 30 September 2026, with Rejin Surendran appointed Chief Digital and Information Officer from 1 October 2026.
LIC increased its stake in Britannia Industries from 4.984% to 5.006% via market purchase of 53,260 shares on 16 September 2026
2026-09-29: Britannia appointed N. Venkataraman as Deputy Managing Director and Ramamurthy Jayaraman as CFO effective 1 October 2026
Britannia Industries Limited will host an Investors/Analysts Conference Call on Friday, 6 November 2026 at 9:00 A.M. IST.
